headline:
Buying In South Metro
Rockdale Allows Backyard Homes
turn_1: Echo, Rockdale County has a new development code, in effect since October 1. It allows a second small home on eligible lots.
turn_2: Like a guest house in the backyard?
turn_3: Yes. They are called accessory dwelling units (ADUs). The code also sets rules for tiny home and cottage home villages.
echo_line: A tiny home sounds great until I count how much stuff I own.
